frontmatter.title: Deer-Vehicle Collision Prediction
frontmatter.description: Built predictive models for real deer collisions data using K-Means clustering, supervised learning (Random Forest, Boosting), and statistical models with feature engineering and resampling techniques (PCA, Bootstrapping, Cross Validation).
key_achievements: Build a clustering map for risk-evaluation.
Use ML tree-based models (random forest, boosting) with feature engineering to tackle overfitting and non-linearity challenge.

frontmatter.title: Fuel Consumption Prediction for ICE Powertrain Vehicles
frontmatter.description: Benchmarking study of ML-based approach for Real-time Fuel Rate Consumption (L/Hr) Prediction for ICEVs with Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM, and TCN, training on real ODB-II data collected from 300 vehicles in Ann Arbor within 1 year.
key_achievements: Approach the data leakage issue
Final model reached 13.87% MAPE and 0.3 MAE (L/hr) on real-life dataset (Feature engineering that brings MAPE from ~55% to 13.87%
SHAP for feature importance analysis
Summary Article: [Medium](https://medium.com/@ameliablog/benchmarking-machine-learning-approach-for-real-world-fuel-consumption-prediction-in-icevs-f657408e888b)

frontmatter.title: Vehicle Defect Detection (Computer Vision, FastAPI, Docker, AWS)
frontmatter.description: A computer vision service that detects defects on vehicle parts using a YOLO object detection model, served through a FastAPI backend, containerized with Docker, and deployed on AWS ECS (Fargate).
key_achievements: Deployed a production-ready vehicle defect detection pipeline.

frontmatter.title: Street Obstacle Detection using RT-DETR
frontmatter.description: Finetuned a RT-DETR model and deployed an app on HuggingFace
key_achievements: Outperformed YOLOv11n in detecting small and blurry objects on test data.
Deployed into a HuggingFace app.

frontmatter.description: Finetuned a YOLOv11n model and deployed an app on HuggingFace
key_achievements: Achieved 0.897 mAP50, 0.75 mAP50_95, 0.92 precision, 0.88 recall on Benchmark dataset
Deployed into a HuggingFace app

frontmatter.title: Vehicle Crash Frequency and Severity Prediction
frontmatter.description: Deployed predictive modeling and diagnostics for an integrated vehicle crash dataset using statistical models (linear regression & logistics regression)
key_achievements: Utilized regression diagnostics for features interpretation.
Feature engineering (log-transform and interactive effect) to achieve R-squared = 85.1% for linear regression and AUC = 68% for logistic regression.
A full comparison with current research literature on the topic.

frontmatter.title: Recommendation Systems on Online Retail
frontmatter.description: Implemented content-based, user-based and item-based collaborative filtering recommendation systems using PySpark to retrieve product recommendations for customer in an online retail scenario.
key_achievements: Built multiple recommendation approaches in PySpark for customer-product matching.
Achieve RMSE = 0.20, Customer Coverage = 99%, Product Coverage = 50% on average.
